decisions.context: Weekly demand must be forecast for each store and product, and the pipeline is owned end to end by a small data science team.

alternatives.label: One batch pipeline for training and forecasting
pros: Weekly run reliability: one scheduled path
cons: Fast model iteration: changes can disrupt runs

alternatives.label: Separate training and forecast pipelines
pros: Weekly run reliability: isolate forecast execution
Fast model iteration: train models independently
cons: End-to-end ownership: more components to operate

decisions.rationale: Weekly run reliability decides the choice: isolate production forecasting from model development, while accepting extra operational components.
consequences: Training and forecasting need a shared model handoff.
The small team must maintain two workflows.

decisions.decision: How should past forecasts be reproduced?
decisions.context: The system must reproduce forecasts for any past week; doing so requires preserving the inputs and model state used for each run.

alternatives.label: Version data, code, configuration, and model artifacts per run
pros: Forecast reproducibility: retain complete run inputs
cons: End-to-end ownership: storage and versioning overhead

alternatives.label: Keep only the latest data and model
cons: Forecast reproducibility: past runs cannot be reconstructed

chosen.label: Version data, code, configuration, and model artifacts per run

decisions.rationale: Forecast reproducibility decides the choice; retaining each run’s dependencies costs storage and lifecycle management.
consequences: Each run must record immutable input and artifact references.

decisions.decision: How should model ideas reach production?
decisions.context: The team wants new model ideas in production quickly without breaking the weekly forecast run.

alternatives.label: Promote models through validation and staged release
pros: Weekly run reliability: validate before promotion
Fast model iteration: parallel candidate evaluation
cons: Fast model iteration: promotion adds a step

alternatives.label: Replace the production model directly
pros: Fast model iteration: shortest path to production
cons: Weekly run reliability: unvalidated changes can break runs

chosen.label: Promote models through validation and staged release

decisions.rationale: Weekly run reliability is the deciding driver; staged validation costs some release speed but reduces the chance that experiments disrupt the scheduled run.
consequences: A validation and promotion process must be maintained.
Production needs a known-good model fallback.
